test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: If 2 is added to each even digit and 2 is added to each odd digit in the number 7362145, what will be the sum of all the odd digits in the new number thus formed?
solution:
Given number: 7362145

Condition: 2 is added to each even digit and 2 is added to each odd digit.

Let's apply the condition to each digit:

 
• Original digit: 7 (Odd) → 7 + 2 = 9
 
• Original digit: 3 (Odd) → 3 + 2 = 5
 
• Original digit: 6 (Even) → 6 + 2 = 8
 
• Origina
